text_block_list.text:
One day, while walking around the academy 
grounds……

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Dammit... I can't... reach!

It seems Narita Taishin is jumping to try 
and reach some handouts caught in a tree, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...What are you staring at? It's getting 
really annoying.
choice_data_list: I thought I'd lend a hand.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Huh? ……Don't make fun of me. I can grab it 
just fine. Leave me alone.
choice_data_list: At least let me cheer you on!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Huh? ……Don't make fun of me. I can grab it 
just fine. Leave me alone.
choice_data_list: At least let me cheer you on!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Shuddup! Mind your own business already!

...In the end, since they kept refusing, I 
decided to quietly watch over them to make 
sure there were no injuries.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: I'll win it, no matter what it takes...!

Narita Taishin continued to jump with 
incredible stamina after that... And then, 
at long last—!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ――All right, got it!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, won through sheer grit. Look at me 
go!

If you persevere without giving up, even 
the highest goals are within reach.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Back off! I told you, your meddling isn't 
welcome!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...Ghhh! Ah, jeez! Fine, I get it 
already!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
I'll finish this up fast. And after that, 
leave me the hell alone!

Working together with Narita Taishin, 
searching for pedestals and pulling down 
branches, the attempts continued...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: All right, at this rate... hnnngh!!

At last, using sheer leg speed, the 
handouts were retrieved!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
*sigh*, that felt like an unnecessary 
drain on my energy. ...Still――

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...That actually helped quite a bit. 
Surprisingly so.

There was much to learn from how Narita 
Taishin used her body—especially her leg 
power.
